in_marathi.name: Pushkarraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lake of Flowers
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pushkarraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the word Pushkar, which means 'a lake filled with lotus flowers'. It is believed that taking a dip in a Pushkar Lake brings good fortune, prosperity and blessings.

in_bengali.name: Pushkarraj

in_bengali.long_meaning: Pushkarraj একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। A name derived from the word Pushkar, which means 'a lake filled with lotus flowers'. It is believed that taking a dip in a Pushkar Lake brings good fortune, prosperity and blessings.
